title: Get insurance quotes
summary: Obtain quotes for D&O, E&O, general liability, and cyber insurance.

parts.title: Determine required coverage types
parts.guidance: Assess exposures from the company’s people, locations, product, customer contracts and assets. Distinguish coverage required by applicable rules or contracts from protection chosen for business risks. Discuss gaps and exclusions with a licensed broker, then decide which coverage types and limits to seek. Quotes should address the same exposures so the later comparison is meaningful.

parts.title: Compile company info for application
parts.guidance: Gather the business description, revenue, payroll, locations, claims history and operational facts requested by insurers. Check the period and entities covered by each question. Resolve unknown security or historical facts with the people who can verify them. The authorized applicant reviews material representations before the completed application is sent.

parts.title: Submit applications to brokers
parts.guidance: Send the applicant-approved answers and requested coverage to the selected brokers through their verified secure channels. Keep the exact submission for comparison with later questions and quotes. Track which markets receive it, and correct inconsistent information across submissions. Give underwriting clarification requests to the person who knows the facts before an answer is returned.

parts.title: Wait for quotes (3-5 days)
parts.guidance: Follow up on outstanding underwriting questions and expected quote dates with the broker. Keep estimates current as markets respond, decline or ask for more information. Resolve material application changes with the applicant before sending them. Move to comparison when the buyer has enough written offers to assess coverage and understands which markets or terms are still pending.

parts.title: Compare quotes and recommend
parts.guidance: Compare quotes for the same entities, activities, limits and start date. Examine retentions, exclusions, defense terms, endorsements and claims conditions with the broker, including gaps against customer requirements. Present the buyer with the meaningful tradeoffs and unresolved wording. A cheaper premium should be understood alongside what coverage and conditions change.

parts.title: Select and bind coverage
parts.guidance: The authorized buyer approves the insurer, terms, premium and effective date after outstanding conditions are resolved. Send the binding instruction and arrange the approved payment. Obtain written coverage confirmation, then compare the issued policy with the quote and endorsements. Keep discrepancies open with the broker until the company has the coverage it agreed to buy.

verify.how: The carrier issues the policy and a certificate of insurance (COI) you can hand to counterparties.

geoNotes.summary: One line is compulsory: employers' liability insurance (≥ £5m from an authorised insurer) from the day you employ anyone, with fines of up to £2,500 per uninsured day — D&O/cyber remain optional buys.

Workplace-accident cover is not shopped for: statutory accident insurance via the sector's Berufsgenossenschaft (DGUV system) is automatic and mandatory — the commercial quotes are for D&O, cyber and Betriebshaftpflicht.

metadata.supportReason: Insurance quoting platforms lack APIs. System guides through requirements, compiles company data, tracks quotes.
